content.title: What’s New at the 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo™ | Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo
content.text: Celebrating America’s 250 The Rodeo is an official program partner of America 250, will serve as a founding partner for America Gives, helping to log and track volunteer hours alongside others across the country. Branded Rodeo and America 250 merchandise includes items such as a koozie, hat and t-shirt. Guests can purchase these items and official Rodeo merchandise locations across Rodeo grounds. Annual items like jackets, vests, gold badges, and souvenir cup will feature a nod to America 250. For all 21-days, American flags will surround the bow-legged H photo op. A Rockin’ America concert will happen at 4:15 p.m., daily on the Junction Stage, presented by Woodside Energy. Red, white, and blue bandanas will be given to attendees at the Junction Stage during the concert. ATTRACTIONS & ACTIVITIES Reimagining the Junction Stage, presented by Woodside Energy The Junction Stage is being reimagined as a two-story, double-decker tent that adds seating and introduces a second-floor cool zone. Charro on the Road, sponsored by La Michoacana Meat Market Get ready to lasso as the one-and-only Tomas Garcilazo brings his award-winning rodeo act to the grounds in 2026. The third-generation charro will perform La Charreria in the Junction across from Fun on the Farm and Born to Buck, presented by Oxy. Performances will take place all 21 days of the Rodeo; times will be available on the RODEOHOUSTON Mobile App, powered by AXS. Cody Johnson Concert-Only Performance: Multi-platform country music star Cody Johnson will return to RODEOHOUSTON® for a special concert-only performance on Sunday, March 22, 2026. This marks Johnson’s sixth appearance at RODEOHOUSTON and just the fourth concert-only performance in event history. He is also the only entertainer, aside from George Strait, to perform on the 21st night of Rodeo. Jon Pardi and Randy Houser will open the evening, with Pardi making his fourth RODEOHOUSTON appearance and Houser stepping onto the star stage for the first time. Doors to NRG Stadium will open at 5 p.m. Randy Houser will open the concert, Jon Pardi will follow, and Cody Johnson will close the evening. Johnson will start at approximately 8:30 p.m. The RODEOHOUSTON competition will occur through the first 20 days of the event, beginning on Monday, March 2, with Finals being held on Saturday, March 21. There is no rodeo competition scheduled before the Cody Johnson concert, however, all activities on the grounds, including shopping and dining areas, carnival, livestock and horse show competitions, and other exhibits and attractions at NRG Park, will be open to the public on Sunday, March 22. The Cajun Cowboy – Bacon Jam Beignets & Brisket Boudin Balls and Shrimp and Andouille Sausage on a Stick The Teahouse – Loaded Platter Combo Waffle Chix – Strawberries and Cream Waffle Stick New Food Vendors 1932 Cattleman’s Club Chute 32 Mama Tina’s Gumbo New Fine Dining Experience by Fertitta Entertainment: 1932 Cattleman’s Club The Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo is proud to announce a new fine dining experience by Fertitta Entertainment, a world-renowned hospitality company recognized for culinary excellence, innovative concepts, and immersive guest experiences. This collaboration will introduce a high-end, full-service dining destination, celebrating the bold flavors, exceptional hospitality, and Western flair that define the spirit of Houston’s largest annual event. The new 1932 Cattleman’s Club will blend culinary artistry with Western sophistication. The menu celebrates the bold flavors of contemporary American cuisine. The venue, located at NRG Park on Stadium Drive, outside of NRG Stadium’s East entrance, will feature both lunch and dinner service, complemented by the children’s menu designed to bring new flavors to Rodeo’s youngest guests. Late-night offerings will also cater to fans looking for elevated, easy-access dining after the rodeo and concert performance. About Chute 32 Chute 32 is an all-new quick-service restaurant operated by Fertitta Entertainment, located just outside the East VIP Club entrance and north of the fine-dining restaurant. This counter-service kitchen will feature a brand-new menu, including Wagyu on a stick, lobster rolls, the midnight cowboy dog, smoked brisket nachos and a loaded spud potato. MERCHANDISE New Official Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Merchandise includes: Scarves Woven blankets Stationery Christmas ornaments Shop these items at new locations throughout the Rodeo grounds and in the online store. New Shopping American Grains Archundi & Co. Certified Hustler Apparel Chapman Fashion Howdy House Kids Keja Jewelry Mostly Chocolate Novi Creations Rock ‘Em Boots Rockin’ AB Rosemary and Sage Ryan’s Woodworking Tin Roof Home Tru 180 Lane Boots Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Collection Crafted in collaboration between the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo’s Chairman of the Board, Pat Mann Phillips, and the artisans at Lane Boots, this exclusive collection celebrates the legacy, grit, and grace that define Western heritage. Each boot design honors the Rodeo’s enduring mission—supporting agriculture, youth education, and the spirit of the West—through handcrafted details inspired by the traditions that laid the organization’s lasting legacy. From the RODEOHOUSTON® bronc silhouette etched in suede to the detailed stitching that honors our founding year, every element reflects the deep roots that built the world’s largest rodeo and the generations who keep it alive. This 2026 collection includes a bootie, a knee high, and a square toe version for women, and a square toe option for men. Read more about the limited-edition boots HERE. HEYDUDE Collaboration HEYDUDE and the Rodeo are collaborating again on a custom shoe you can view and purchase at their new exhibit location just inside Hall E, NRG Center. Make sure to stop by and look at the new reimaged design for 2026! Limited quantities are available. New Activations Hennessy Fever Tree Visit College Station Wrangler Hennessy Roadhouse In a brand-new activation near the Junction area, guests can experience the partner’s unique fusion of Texas culture and Hennessy. The space will feature a handpicked lineup of Texas DJs, exclusive prizes, customized merchandise, dancing and more. Visit College Station Visit College Station is bringing the Heart of Aggieland to a Texas-size stage at NRG Center. Guests can stop by their booth to feel like a snapshot of the city, blending deep-rooted traditions, Texas A&M spirit and the energy of a growing must-visit destination. SPECIAL DAYS Here is a look at what’s new on select Special Days. This does not reflect the entire schedule for each day. For more information, visit RODEOHOUSTON.com. Monday, March 2: Opening Day, presented by Shell Federal Credit Union Beginning at 2 p.m. the first 10,000 guests will receive a 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo belt buckle. Wednesday, March 4: Armed Forces Appreciation Day, presented by Crown Royal The Rodeo grounds will be dressed in red, white and blue. At the stadium, a powerful display of 70,000 hand-held American flags will take place during the rappel, exemplifying the America Waves initiative that brings communities together nationwide to simultaneously wave flags, celebrate our nation’s 250th anniversary, and recognize the individuals who have shaped our nation throughout its history. Monday, March 9: First Responders Day, presented by BP America New Volunteer First Responder of the Year Award: The Armed Forces Appreciation Committee has added a new category to recognize outstanding volunteer first responders. The award category will recognize one single volunteer and one group. The public ceremony will take place on the second floor of NRG Center at 4 p.m. NRG STADIUM Cantina, presented by Casamigos Tequila In its largest partnership with the Rodeo, Casamigos Tequila is bringing a reimagined atmosphere to the 5,000 square-foot space, including exclusive ready-to-drink beverages made with its Blanco and Reposado expressions. Two specialty cocktails are also being crafted, including the Watermelon Chili Margarita and the Casa Paloma. Cowboy Cam, sponsored by Carnival The stadium’s Cowboy Cam is all new, featuring an AI-generated animation on the big screen. Throughout the Rodeo, attendees can scan a QR code to generate a personalized AI photo and have it sent directly to them to keep. Super Series Presentation, sponsored by Alberta Boot Company Outfitters All 45 RODEOHOUSTON Super Series winners will take home more than just a title, thanks to Alberta Boot Company Outfitters, which will award custom RODEOHOUSTON-branded boots featuring each athlete’s initials. RODEOHOUSTON® Competition Updates We’re excited to welcome 70 first-time competitors to RODEOHOUSTON this year, highlighting new talent while showcasing Houston and the volunteers who bring the Rodeo to life. RODEOHOUSTON® Hall of Fame Champion bull rider Ty Murray and legendary bucking bull Bodacious will be inducted into the RODEOHOUSTON Hall of Fame as its third class. Bodacious is the first rodeo animal to be inducted. Known for his unmatched power and unpredictable athleticism, he made a lasting impression during his appearances at RODEOHOUSTON inside the Astrodome in the mid-1990s. Murray is a 6X RODEOHOUSTON Champion including four all-around titles and two bull riding titles. He was also one of the last contestants to be crowned All-Around Champion at RODEOHOUSTON. An induction ceremony will take place Tuesday, March 10, 2026, in front of the permanent display, located on the second floor of NRG Center. A temporary display can be seen inside NRG Stadium, Section 133, for fans to visit throughout the 21-day event. Website and RODEOHOUSTON Mobile App, powered by AXS Visit rodeohouston.com and download the RODEOHOUSTON Mobile app to best plan and prepare for your visit to the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo. Purchase or access tickets, load up on carnival packs and livestream both the Rodeo and livestock show. Access the interactive map for turn-by-turn directions to all your favorite rides, games and food.
